title: Chapter 401 You Are Finished
content:
Chapter 401 You Are Finished

The scene suddenly fell into a tense state.

Lu Xue also saw that the other party was not kind, but she was not angry at all, but said calmly: "This fellow Taoist, I am from the deserted city, and I hope I can give you some face."

People in the deserted city.

Lu Xue revealed that she was from Huangcheng and didn't want the other party to give her any face. After all, who has the face of Huangcheng?

She said this just to make the other party retreat and get less trouble.

After experiencing the wars of various races, and Lu Xue has been the master of the Human Emperor Palace for a long time, Lu Xue has become much more tolerant of people of the same race.

But at this moment, a sudden laugh sounded inside the frame.

Immediately afterwards, a male voice came from inside.

"I didn't expect that in this wilderness, I could meet people who pretend to be holy places."

"You are so brave!"

The car door opened again, and a man in a dark gold patterned robe walked out slowly with a slightly gloomy face and appeared in the sight of Lu Xue and the others.

When the man saw Lu Xue's face for the first time, his eyes couldn't help but drifted.

What a beautiful woman.

In an instant, little thoughts arose in his heart.

Feeling the man's aggressive gaze, even though Lu Xue had experienced a lot and looked down on time, she felt a little uncomfortable at this moment.

The old man Broken Sword on the side immediately stood in front of Lu Xue.

"Boy, no matter who you are, please respect it."

The old man Broken Sword ignored the other party's possible noble identity, because no matter how noble the other party's identity was, he could not be as good as the woman behind him.

The daughter of the Lord of the Huangcheng City, the value of this identity is unparalleled.

Next to the man, the old man also saw his master's thoughts, and then shouted angrily: "Bold! You dare to pretend to be a person from the holy land. We have the right to subdue you and others and take you back to the holy land to punish you severely. We advise you to surrender immediately. ! ”

The old man is not low in strength, and he can definitely be regarded as the upper-level combat power among the current human race.

This also indirectly confirms the identity of this strange man.

Perhaps, this man is really from the deserted city.

The holy land they mentioned was also known as the holy land of the human race because of the status of the Wasteland City in the entire Chaos Realm. It is almost a fantasy for foreign races to enter.

"Miss Lu, what should I do now?"

The old man Broken Sword was at a loss at this moment. He had been pressing his right hand on the broken sword at his waist for a long time, but he was reluctant to draw the sword because he was really afraid that the other party was from the deserted city, or his status in the deserted city was not low. If you continue this sword, don’t really cause any big trouble for yourself.

But he asked Lu Xue and there was nothing wrong. As long as Lu Xue nodded, no matter what the other party's identity was, he would definitely be safe and sound.

At this time, Lu Xue was also looking at the other person. She couldn't see any expression, but anyone could feel that she was not in a good mood now.

After a long silence, Lu Xue suddenly asked, "What's your name?"

She is giving the other party a chance. If she can think of someone, she may be able to resolve this unnecessary contradiction.

Unexpectedly, the other party smiled evilly and mocked Lu Xue, "By you, you are not qualified to know my name."

Lu Xue:...

Old Man Broken Sword: This kid, you won’t be useful if you give you a chance.

Ao Qing: I was almost sleepy when I saw it. When will I fight?

At this time, the man had already issued sanctions on the old man beside him against Lu Xue and the others, "Old Wu, please take action and take these two people down, oh by the way,"

The man pointed at Ao Qing, who had been silent on Lu Xue's shoulder again, and said, "Catch that dragon too, just right, these two wolves should be replaced."

The two blue flame wolf kings immediately raised their heads and roared to the sky.

I don’t know whether it’s joy or sorrow.

"Grandma Li, I don't show my power. Do you really think I'm a loach?!"

Hearing the man's words, Ao Qing couldn't help it. In just a moment, he soared into the sky, and a golden light flashed, turning into an extremely huge dragon that covered the sky and the sun.

The terrifying dragon power poured down. After experiencing the baptism of the Heavenly Demon Clan, Ao Qing's suppression on the two Blue Flame Wolf Kings who are also the Heavenly Demon Clan is extremely terrifying.

Under Ao Qing's pressure, the two blue flame wolf kings had already crawled on the ground, trembling all over.

On the frame, the man faced Ao Qing without any fear, but instead had an excitement in his eyes. He could not imagine how powerful he would be if he could conquer this giant dragon.

By the way, there is no one else, well, it’s all his.

This time I went out, I really gained a lot.

At this moment, he didn't notice at all. The old man beside him looked up at Ao Qing's figure, widened his eyes, opened his mouth, and his whole body was tense, and the fear in his eyes was almost overwhelming.

He is not weak, but it is precisely because of this that he knows the gap between him and this dragon.

And it is obvious that his master didn't know at all.

"Old Wu, why are you still being stunned here? Take them down quickly!"

The man reacted and saw that the old man was still standing there and was indifferent, he couldn't help but frown and urged him.

At this time, the old man slowly turned his head and looked at the man. His pale face was filled with fine beads of sweat. He moved his throat and said hoarsely, "Master, why don't you forget this matter."

"Forget it? Mr. Wu, what nonsense are you talking about?"

The man frowned, but looking at the old man's face that was very wrong, he also felt something was wrong.

However, he was obviously used to being arrogant. Even if he guessed that the other party was not easy, he still ignored it automatically in his subconscious.

At this time, the old man Broken Sword suddenly chuckled and said, "Boy, don't you understand? The person next to you is not our opponent."

"What!"

Hearing the old man Broken Sword's words, the man's eyes widened and looked disbelief.

He knew very well how strong Wu Lao was. After all, he had always been by his side to protect his existence. How could his strength be low?

This is the first time he has heard that Mr. Wu is not good at all.

But seeing Mr. Wu not denying it, his expression became worse and worse.

After a moment of silence, the man snorted coldly, "Let you go this time."

As he said that, the man was about to turn his head back into the frame.

But at this time, Ao Qing, who was hovering in the sky, suddenly growled: "You let us go, I don't plan to let you go!"

After saying that, Ao Qing rushed down and opened his bloody mouth.

"Master, be careful!"

Boom!

With a loud bang, the entire frame was instantly shattered, and the two blue flame wolf kings were shaken away to the distance, not knowing life and death.

It is hard to imagine that the seemingly sturdy frame did not even breathe in Ao Qing's mouth.

As the smoke of gunpowder dissipated, the old man appeared in the distance with a embarrassed man.

At this moment, the man looked angry and stared at Ao Qing and Lu Xue tightly, and said in a deep voice: "You are finished!"
